notes.title: Performance Update for Some Jello and a Hard Place! - v1.6.1
notes.notes:
[b]Basically no big changes [/b]

After doing some play testing, I realized that the game would not run in a playable state on low spec hardware. So I added an extra setting to disable the visual lagging low hardware (Parallax BG)

New updates just fixing minor bugs on 1.6.1 will be marked with a lowercase letter appending the version number on the title screen.
